title: Pure Lyrilusc
summary: Pure Lyrilusc swarm and control build, with generic staples. Lyriluscs are Level 1 WIND Winged Beasts that easily Special Summon each other to assemble multi-material Rank 1 Xyz Monsters with stacking protection and repeated interruption.

summary.title: Starters
points: Lyrilusc - Turquoise Warbler Special Summons itself from the hand while you control no monsters, then brings another Lyrilusc from the hand or GY.
Lyrilusc - Bird Call adds a Lyrilusc monster from the Deck to your hand or sends it to the GY, then optionally Special Summons a Lyrilusc with a different name from your hand.
Lyrilusc - Cobalt Sparrow searches a Level 1 Winged Beast when Special Summoned, and grants targeting immunity to an Xyz Monster using it as material.
Lyrilusc - Celestine Wagtail searches a Lyrilusc Spell/Trap on Special Summon, and can attach itself from the GY to a Lyrilusc Xyz Monster as material.

summary.title: Opening: Turquoise Warbler + Cobalt Sparrow
steps: Special Summon Lyrilusc - Turquoise Warbler from hand onto an empty board, triggering its effect to Special Summon Lyrilusc - Cobalt Sparrow from hand.
Cobalt Sparrow triggers on summon to search Lyrilusc - Sapphire Swallow or Lyrilusc - Celestine Wagtail from your Deck.
Overlay Turquoise Warbler and Cobalt Sparrow into Lyrilusc - Recital Starling; detach a material to search Lyrilusc - Beryl Canary.
Activate Beryl Canary in hand targeting Cobalt Sparrow in the GY to Special Summon both, locking Extra Deck summons to Xyz Monsters for the turn.
Overlay both into a second Recital Starling or Lyrilusc - Ensemblue Robin with multiple materials and targeting protection.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Lyrilusc - Ensemblue Robin detaches an Xyz Material as a Quick Effect whenever the opponent Special Summons a monster to return it to the hand, triggering multiple times per turn.

Lyrilusc - Assembled Nightingale attacks directly, attacks once per material each Battle Phase, and detaches a material as a Quick Effect to make all Lyriluscs indestructible and prevent all battle damage you would take for the turn.
Lyrilusc - Promenade Thrush detaches a material to shuffle an opponent's Spell or Trap Card into the Deck, and boosts ATK across all face-up Xyz Monsters you control.
Lyrilusc - Recital Starling boosts monster ATK on summon and makes your opponent take all battle damage you would take from battles involving it.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Lyrilusc - Bird Call serves as the primary searcher and extender, assembling two Level 1 bodies with a single card.
Lyrilusc - Bird Strike negates the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls while you control a Lyrilusc monster.
Lyrilusc - Bird Sanctuary targets two Xyz Monsters you control to attach one to the other as material, and draws a card if an Xyz has three or more materials.
Lyrilusc - Phantom Feathers matches an opponent's monster's ATK and Level to a Lyrilusc monster you control, weakening attackers and disrupting Xyz or Synchro setups.

main: Searches a Level 1 Winged Beast when Special Summoned.
Summons itself with another Level 1 Winged Beast from the hand.
Summons itself onto an empty board; brings another Lyrilusc.
Searches a Lyrilusc Spell/Trap; attaches itself to a Lyrilusc Xyz.
Revives a Lyrilusc with itself from the hand.
Adds or mills a Lyrilusc, then summons another.
Negates every face-up monster they control.
Stacks one Xyz onto another; draws with three materials.
Sets their ATK to your Lyrilusc's and their Levels/Ranks to 1.
extra: Rank 1: attacks once per material; protects Lyriluscs.
Rank 1: searches a Level 1 Winged Beast.
Fusion of Assembled Nightingale: unaffected; burns.
